framework: NCERT Learning Outcomes at the Elementary Stage
learning_objective:
Classify given algebraic items such as 5x and 5x = 25 as expressions or equations.
Label the LHS and the RHS of a given linear equation.
Determine whether a proposed value is a solution by comparing the two sides.
Count the distinct variables in a given expression and decide whether it qualifies.
Inspect an expression and state whether the highest power of its variable is one.
Recognise a linear equation in one variable by applying both restrictions together.
Apply the same operation to both sides of an equation and write the new equation.
Check a proposed solution of 2x - 3 = 7 by evaluating both sides at that value.
Transpose a term across the equality sign and name the balanced step it replaces.
Rearrange 2x - 3 = x + 2 so that the variable terms stand on one side only.
Justify subtracting a term in the variable from both sides of an equation.
Select the multiplier that clears the fractions in 5x + 7/2 = 3x/2 - 14.
Calculate the lowest common multiple of the denominators and use it to clear the fractions.
Expand the brackets on both sides of an equation before transposing any term.
Evaluate the LHS and the RHS separately at the solution and compare the two values.
Formulate a linear equation in one variable from a stated problem on ages or perimeters.
